04/ Dated 11.03.2025  Heard the parties.
The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Deoghar (Cyber) P.S. Case No. 68 of 2024,
for the offence registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B), 66(C), 66(D) & 84(C) of the Information Technology Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Deoghar.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Deoghar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Bail application of the petitioner was earlier permitted to be withdrawn in B.A. No.7384/2024, vide order dated 28.11.2024.

On 26.06.2024, Deoghar Police, on the basis of confidential information that cyber criminals have assembled near railway line at Kasya, raided the place of occurrence and apprehended the petitioner and co-accused.
It is alleged that three mobile phones were recovered from the possession of the petitioner.
It appears that some witnesses have stated that petitioner had cheated them.
It was submitted that petitioner has remained in custody for about nine months.
It was further submitted that similarly situated co-accused Sakur Ansari has been granted bail by this Court earlier.
